intro: Good morning! It's been a packed 48 hours: U.S.-Iran clashes tested a fragile ceasefire, quantum computing made its Wall Street debut, and the NBA Finals tipped off in dramatic fashion. Grab your coffee and see how many you can get right.

questions.question: Iran fired missiles at Bahrain this week, making it an especially provocative strike for the United States. Why is Bahrain strategically significant to the U.S. military?
options: It hosts the U.S. Army's Central Command headquarters
It is home to the U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet
It houses the CIA's primary Middle East listening station
It is the site of the U.S. Air Force's main regional refueling hub
questions.explanation: Bahrain is home to the U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet, making Iran's missile strike there a direct provocation against American naval forces. The missiles were intercepted before causing damage.

questions.question: State media photos showed North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visiting a new facility widely believed to be producing what material?
questions.explanation: State media released photos of Kim visiting what analysts believe is a new plant producing weapons-grade uranium, signalling continued advancement of North Korea's nuclear weapons program.

questions.question: The U.S. House passed a war powers resolution directing President Trump to remove American forces from the Iran conflict. What was the vote tally?
options: The chamber tabled it without a vote
questions.explanation: The House voted 215–208 to approve the war powers resolution, with four Republicans breaking ranks to join Democrats — a rare rebuke of the president's military authority.

questions.question: President Trump announced he would nominate whom as the next U.S. Attorney General, after firing Pam Bondi in April?
questions.explanation: Trump said he would nominate Todd Blanche, who has been serving as acting attorney general and was previously Trump's personal defense lawyer during his criminal trials.

questions.question: Which semiconductor giant saw its stock tumble roughly 15% after its fiscal Q2 revenue of $22.19 billion came in just below analyst expectations, denting the AI trade?
questions.explanation: Broadcom's shares fell about 15% after reporting Q2 revenue of $22.19 billion, slightly below the $22.27 billion analysts had expected. The miss prompted a broader rotation out of chip stocks, though the Dow still hit a record close of 51,561.

questions.question: Quantum computing company Quantinuum raised $1.68 billion in its June 2026 IPO, pricing above its initial range at $60 per share. On which exchange does it trade, and under what ticker?
questions.explanation: Quantinuum began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker 'QNT' on June 4, 2026. Shares opened at $68, above its $60 IPO price, giving the full-stack quantum computing firm a market value of roughly $15.7 billion.

questions.question: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope made a landmark discovery on interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS — the first direct detection of what substance on an object from another star system?
questions.explanation: JWST detected methane on interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS, marking the first time methane has been directly detected on a visitor from outside our solar system, revealing unusual chemistry for an interstellar object.

questions.question: A Phase 3 trial published in the New England Journal of Medicine found that the oral drug daraxonrasib nearly doubled median overall survival — from 6.6 months to 13.2 months — in patients with previously treated metastatic what cancer?
questions.explanation: Daraxonrasib showed a striking improvement in metastatic pancreatic cancer, a disease with historically grim prognosis, nearly doubling the median survival compared with standard chemotherapy in the Phase 3 trial.

questions.question: The 2026 NBA Finals opened with the New York Knicks defeating the San Antonio Spurs 105–95 in Game 1. Which Knick led all scorers with 30 points, including 13 in the fourth quarter?
questions.explanation: Jalen Brunson scored a game-high 30 points, 19 of them in the second half, to lead New York's comeback and give the Knicks a 1–0 series lead on the road in San Antonio.

questions.question: Josh Hart posted 15 rebounds, 5 assists, and 4 steals in NBA Finals Game 1, making him only the second player in Finals history with that stat line. Who was the first?
questions.explanation: Larry Bird is the only other player to record 15 rebounds, 5 assists, and 4 steals in a single NBA Finals game. Hart's 15 boards were the most by a player 6-foot-5 or shorter in a Finals game since Elgin Baylor grabbed 20 in the 1970 Finals.
